CustomField.description: Subheading text for the edit modal opened from a Repeater or Table row. Passed as edit-modal-subheading to c-flow-form-repeat / c-flow-data-table. Shown when Enable Edit Action is checked.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Smaller text shown under the edit popup's title. Requires Enable Edit Action; leave blank to omit it.
CustomField.label: Modal Subtitle
